Interface Module

ApiKeys, AvajeValidation, BasicAuth, CaffeineCacheModule, DataModule, DavModule, FormLoginModule, GrpcModule, JakartaValidation, JsonModule, JsonModule, JteModule, LimiterModule, McpModule, MicrometerModule, NdjsonModule, OAuthServer, OidcModule, OpenApiModule, PrometheusModule, ProtobufModule, ProtovalidateValidation, Scheduler, SecurityModule, TestSecurity, ThymeleafModule, ViewModule, ViteModule, XmlModule
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Module
A reusable piece of an App: routes, middleware, services. An extension is a module shipped in a jar, and an application splits itself into modules the same way. 

 public final class Billing implements Module {
     @Override public void install(App app) {
         app.add(Invoices.class).scan("com.acme.billing");
     }
 }
